# Diagram types

excaliplant renders 29 kinds of diagram. Pick the kind that matches the request and start from the example file (paths are relative to this skill's folder).

Diagrams that share `@startuml` are told apart by their content (arrows, keywords such as `class`, `participant`, `state`, `actor`). If the wrong kind is detected, make the intent clearer or use the dedicated start keyword where one exists.

| Diagram         | Kind              | Start keywords                | Highlights                                                                                  | Example                                               |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Sequence        | `sequence`        | `@startuml`, `@startsequence` | Participants, all arrow styles, activations, notes, fragments, dividers, autonumber, boxes. | `assets/examples/sequence-checkout-flow.puml.txt`     |
| Class & IE      | `class`           | `@startuml`                   | Classes, interfaces, enums, generics, members, packages, all UML relations, IE crow's feet. | `assets/examples/class-shop-domain.puml.txt`          |
| Activity        | `activity`        | `@startuml`, `@startactivity` | New syntax with if/switch/while/repeat/fork/split, partitions, notes and swimlanes.         | `assets/examples/activity-order-processing.puml.txt`  |
| State           | `state`           | `@startuml`                   | Composite states, concurrent regions, choice, fork/join, history, entry/exit actions.       | `assets/examples/state-order-lifecycle.puml.txt`      |
| Component & C4  | `component`       | `@startuml`                   | Components, interfaces, ports, packages, nodes — and C4 via `!include <C4/...>`.            | `assets/examples/component-c4-container.puml.txt`     |
| Use case        | `usecase`         | `@startuml`                   | Actors, use cases, system boundaries, include/extend.                                       | `assets/examples/usecase-checkout.puml.txt`           |
| Deployment      | `deployment`      | `@startuml`                   | Nodes, clouds, databases, queues, artifacts and nested deployment targets.                  | `assets/examples/deployment-kubernetes.puml.txt`      |
| Object          | `object`          | `@startuml`                   | Objects with fields, maps (`key => value`) and links.                                       | `assets/examples/object-runtime-snapshot.puml.txt`    |
| Timing          | `timing`          | `@startuml`, `@starttiming`   | Robust, concise, clock, binary and analog signals with messages and constraints.            | `assets/examples/timing-sensor.puml.txt`              |
| Gantt           | `gantt`           | `@startgantt`, `@startuml`    | Tasks, dependencies, milestones, progress, resources, closed days, today marker.            | `assets/examples/gantt-release-plan.puml.txt`         |
| Mind map        | `mindmap`         | `@startmindmap`               | OrgMode/Markdown outlines on both sides, colours, boxless nodes.                            | `assets/examples/mindmap-excaliplant.puml.txt`        |
| WBS             | `wbs`             | `@startwbs`                   | Work breakdown structures as org charts.                                                    | `assets/examples/wbs-website-relaunch.puml.txt`       |
| JSON            | `json`            | `@startjson`                  | JSON documents as linked tables with highlights.                                            | `assets/examples/json-api-response.puml.txt`          |
| YAML            | `yaml`            | `@startyaml`                  | YAML documents as linked tables.                                                            | `assets/examples/yaml-ci-config.puml.txt`             |
| ArchiMate       | `archimate`       | `@startuml`                   | ArchiMate elements by layer with icons, junctions and `Rel_*` macros.                       | `assets/examples/archimate-insurance.puml.txt`        |
| Chen ER         | `chen`            | `@startchen`                  | Chen ER diagrams: entities, weak entities, relationships, attributes, cardinalities.        | `assets/examples/chen-movie-rental.puml.txt`          |
| Network         | `nwdiag`          | `@startnwdiag`, `@startuml`   | Networks, addresses, multi-homed nodes, groups and peer links.                              | `assets/examples/nwdiag-office-network.puml.txt`      |
| Salt wireframe  | `salt`            | `@startsalt`, `@startuml`     | Wireframes: grids, buttons, inputs, check boxes, trees, tabs, group boxes.                  | `assets/examples/salt-login-dialog.puml.txt`          |
| EBNF            | `ebnf`            | `@startebnf`                  | EBNF grammars as railroad diagrams.                                                         | `assets/examples/ebnf-json-grammar.puml.txt`          |
| Regex           | `regex`           | `@startregex`                 | Regular expressions as railroad diagrams.                                                   | `assets/examples/regex-email.puml.txt`                |
| Graphviz DOT    | `dot`             | `@startdot`                   | Graphviz DOT graphs laid out with ELK.                                                      | `assets/examples/dot-pipeline.puml.txt`               |
| Chronology      | `chronology`      | `@startchronology`            | Events and spans on a time line with links.                                                 | `assets/examples/chronology-project-history.puml.txt` |
| Files           | `files`           | `@startfiles`                 | File trees from path lists with notes.                                                      | `assets/examples/files-project-layout.puml.txt`       |
| Chart           | `chart`           | `@startchart`                 | Bar, line, area and scatter charts.                                                         | `assets/examples/chart-quarterly.puml.txt`            |
| AsciiMath       | `math`            | `@startmath`                  | AsciiMath formulas.                                                                         | `assets/examples/math-sum-of-cubes.puml.txt`          |
| LaTeX           | `latex`           | `@startlatex`                 | LaTeX formulas.                                                                             | `assets/examples/latex-gaussian.puml.txt`             |
| Ditaa           | `ditaa`           | `@startditaa`, `@startuml`    | ASCII art boxes, lines, arrows and colour tags.                                             | `assets/examples/ditaa-pipeline.puml.txt`             |
| Legacy activity | `legacy-activity` | `@startuml`                   | The classic `(*) --> "Activity"` syntax with sync bars and branches.                        | `assets/examples/legacy-activity-approval.puml.txt`   |
| Creole          | `creole`          | `@startcreole`                | Rich text with headings, lists, tables and links.                                           | `assets/examples/creole-release-notes.puml.txt`       |

The `kind` is what `excaliplant --list-types` prints and what the JavaScript API reports as `result.kind`.
